newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms say seeking 85,000T of US soybeans.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms say seeking 85,000T of US soybeans.

text.p: Three major South Korean edible oil producers will buy a total of 85,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans by next week for shipment in April, company officials said on Monday.
The three companies are Cheil Jedang Corp, Shindongbang Corp, and Sam Yang Foods Co Ltd.
They said Cheil Jedang and Shindongbang would buy each 35,000 tonnes for shipment in April, while Sam Yang would buy 15,000 tonnes for shipment in early April.
They said the three companies are expected to buy the soybeans at basis over May futures on the Chicago Board of Trade through private negotiations.
The companies' shipments are slated from the U.S. Gulf to the South Korean port city of Inchon.
In February, the three firms bought 85,000 tonnes for shipment in March -- Shindongbang taking 35,000 tonnes, Cheil Jedang 35,000 tonnes and Sam Yang 15,000 tonnes.
